correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact p-morphism definition and checks both directions. Maximal source points cannot map to the target root by the back condition; monotonicity and the back condition then force every nonmaximal value from the colors of its maximal extensions. Conversely the formula is monotone because extension shrinks the set of maximal completions, and the mixed-color case supplies both witnesses required by the back condition. The surjectivity criterion follows from the source root seeing every maximal completion. Exhaustive checks for \(n=1,2\) agree exactly with the formula.

value.rationale: \(\mathbf A_1\) is the canonical generating two-fork whose finite powers characterize \(\mathsf{Cheq}\), so classifying maps onto it is intrinsic rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The result gives a complete structural parametrization, not only a count: every Boolean decision rule on maximal completions extends uniquely to a p-morphism. This shows that the basic quotient space is as large as the full Boolean-function space, a useful boundary fact for p-morphism constructions in the emerging \(\mathsf{Cheq}\) literature.
